Author: PartyPing
Name: PartyPing
Punchline: Discord alerts when Party Finder hits my prog point.
Description: Polls the in-game FFXIV Party Finder, waits for the complete local result stream, filters by duty, normalized prog keywords, open slots, exact local role availability, and ignores listings locked to minimum item level 999. Discord bot mode adds native Open in FFXIV and Join Party buttons. When you join a party, PartyPing keeps all matching PF cards visible and highlights the card belonging to your current party with a live party count. Use /partyping to configure it.
